Definition: Ophrah, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ophrah is three things at once: a man of Judah, the son of Meonothai, and two towns, one in Benjamin and one in Manasseh, the home of Gideon the son of Joash. The town in Manasseh was Gideon's home, where the angel found him threshing wheat in a winepress.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ophrah matters most as Gideon's home: the smallest town in Manasseh was where God called a man hiding in a winepress to save Israel.
